title: Havana, then quitting in Detroit and forming a band at the Savoy
summary: After Cuba he left the show in Detroit and led a seven-piece band at the Savoy for about six months (Welburn's note: Chilton dates it 1927-28).

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Then I left Benbow... I left the theatre and got with Benbow. Then I went all down through the South. I ended up going to Havana -- Havana, Cuba.
I got to Havana, Cuba, then I come home... I quit the show in a place called...was it the Greystone Ballroom...? Not in Cleveland, but...

Detroit. Detroit, Michigan. I quit the show. Stayed there about two or three days. Then someone taken an interest in me and told me to organize a band. I organized a seven-piece band that played at a place called the Savoy on St. Antoine and Hastings. We played there I guess about
Okay. Now, this place in Detroit, it was called the Savoy Ballroom? In Detroit?
No, it wasn't a ballroom. It was just called the Savoy.
Hastings and St. Antoine, one flight upstairs.
How old were you when you organized this band?
Oh, I must have been around 22 or 23 years old.
